title: Space beyond orders hardware for 10 more memorial cubesat missions
big: 5 new stories. Most came from ships and space; the top five are mostly about allies, plus budget and policy.

stories.h: Space Beyond orders hardware for 10 more memorial cubesat missions
stories.what: Space Beyond has ordered enough hardware for 10 follow-on cubesats after growing sales for the Florida startup's first memorial spacecraft, slated to carry cremated remains into orbit in October 2027.
stories.you: The watch item is which orbit and which bus get the next order.

stories.h: Lockheed Martin Secures $1.5B Modification for Trident II D5 Missile Production, Fleet Support
stories.what: The sole-source contract calls for work in Utah, Florida, Colorado and other sites running through 2031.
stories.you: The watch item is who can deliver the munition in volume.

stories.h: Congress is ‘out of time’ to decide on reconciliation, needs to settle topline spending: Sen. Coons
stories.what: If we could get to a bipartisan topline, we could spend the time from Thanksgiving to the end of the year getting a lot of this finished, said Sen. Chris Coons, the top democrat on the Senate Appropriations defense subcommittee.
stories.you: The watch item is whether the memo turns into a restriction on contracts.

idea.h: Synthetic data and test & evaluation for autonomy
idea.why: Simulation and synthetic sensor data to train and certify autonomy when GPS is denied and radios are jammed. New autonomy policy (the June 2026 memo, CSIS definitions) means systems need verification evidence, and the new command gets test powers.
